name: Summit
description: Summit channel plugin — bridges this OpenClaw Gateway to the Summit mobile app over Summit's relay.

relayUrl.label: Relay URL
relayUrl.description: Summit relay to dial. Leave unset to use the hosted relay.

agentName.label: Agent name
agentName.description: Name shown in the Summit app once paired.

stateDir.label: State directory
stateDir.description: Where the pairing identity and reply outbox are stored. Defaults to the plugin state dir.
